channel.title: RateLog — GitHub Copilot changelog
channel.description: Every pricing and usage-limit change RateLog has caught for GitHub Copilot, dated and sourced — no other tools mixed in.

item.title: GitHub Copilot — Flat premium-request quotas replaced with AI Credits
item.description: [changed] GitHub replaced its flat monthly Premium Request quotas (e.g. 300/month for Pro) with a token-consumption-based "AI Credits" system (1 credit = $0.01) across all plans, and introduced a new top individual tier, Copilot Max, at $100/month. Total credit allowances ended up higher than sticker price once bonus credits are included, but billing is now metered rather than a flat predictable count.
